description: This file implements a SQL store for content flagging reviewers in the Mattermost server, including methods for saving and retrieving reviewer settings, managing team settings and reviewers, and handling database transactions.

classes.name: SqlContentFlaggingStore
classes.description: A SQL store for managing content flagging reviewer settings, including team and individual reviewer configurations.

methods.name: newContentFlaggingStore
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new instance of SqlContentFlaggingStore.

methods.name: SaveReviewerSettings
methods.description: Saves reviewer settings, including common reviewers and team settings, within a database transaction.

methods.name: saveCommonReviewers
methods.description: Deletes existing common reviewers and inserts new ones.

methods.name: saveTeamSettings
methods.description: Deletes existing team settings and inserts new team configurations.

methods.name: saveTeamReviewers
methods.description: Deletes existing team reviewers and inserts new reviewer associations.

methods.name: GetReviewerSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current reviewer settings, including common reviewers and team configurations.

methods.name: getCommonReviewers
methods.description: Fetches list of user IDs marked as common reviewers.

methods.name: getTeamSettings
methods.description: Fetches team settings such as enabled status for each team.

methods.name: getTeamReviewers
methods.description: Fetches reviewer user IDs associated with each team.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Empty method placeholder for cache clearing.
